summary: RETEST of iteration_67 notification fixes on the frontend only, at 390x844, as demo@amass.africa. FIX 1 PASS: slow right swipes (1.3s/15 steps, and 3s/30 steps), a slow left swipe, a left swipe held 1.5s before release, and a partial 50px swipe below the threshold all stay on /updates (or /notifications). Each shows the right 'Marked as read/unread' or 'Update dismissed' + Undo toast. Fast swipes (~250ms) still work. A plain tap on an unread row opens /agent/listing/{id}?tab=docs and drops the count by exactly 1. A tap on a read row opens its deep link. FIX 2 PASS: every action changes the count by exactly 1: read 2->1, Undo ->2, mark unread ->3, dismiss unread ->2, Undo ->3, fast read ->2, dismissing a read row leaves 2. The tab badge refreshes from the network (badgeSignal -> GET unread-count) about 1.0-1.5s after the subtitle changes, because it waits for the POST round trip. There is no 30s lag. Mark-all shows 'You're all caught up' and the badge is gone within 0.7s. FIX 3 PASS: all 11 prefs-channels-* rows are full width (x=32, w=326), on one line, with no overflow. The Instant/Daily/Weekly control is indented (x=84) only for the 5 digest categories. The hour rail shows 06:00 in full at scrollLeft 0 and 20:00 in full when scrolled to the end. Chips expose aria-selected and aria-pressed. Smoke checks PASS: the Unread chip toggles and stays on after reload; Clear read in Receipts goes 'Clear 14 read updates' -> 'Tap again to clear 14 read' -> 'Cleared 14 read updates' toast, with unread count unchanged; on /notifications a slow swipe gives the toast with no navigation, and Undo updates the badge. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

issues: The segmented controls (prefs-email-freq-*, prefs-freq-{key}-*) render role=tab but have no aria-selected, so the selected segment is not announced. Add accessibilityState={{selected}} to the segment items.
Channel chips and hour chips are 36px tall, under 44pt. Check that hitSlop is applied.
The hint 'Phone alerts are off above — applies once turned on.' repeats under all 11 categories. Show it once, above the category list.
When the hour rail is scrolled to the end, 06:00 is clipped at the card edge. This is normal horizontal scrolling (only 46px of overflow) and is not a bug.
The badge waits for the POST and then a GET, so it lands about 1-1.5s after the optimistic subtitle change. Optional: set the badge optimistically.
Undo buttons in toasts have no testID. Add testID='toast-action' for tests.

react_native_issues.issue: Reanimated warning, 13 times per session: 'Property [transform] may be overwritten by a layout animation'. The entering/exiting/layout props share an Animated.View with styled shadows. Reference: /app/frontend/src/ui/Toast.tsx:66

action_items: LOW: add accessibilityState={{selected}} to segmented-control items (prefs-email-freq-*, prefs-freq-*-*).
LOW: move the 'Phone alerts are off' hint above the category list instead of repeating it in every category.
LOW: wrap the Toast content in an inner Animated.View, so the layout animation does not overwrite transform (Reanimated warning).
LOW (optional): update the tab badge optimistically before notifyBadges refetches.
critical_code_review_comments: The swipedRecently() flag is module-global, so a tap on any row within ~600ms after another row settles is ignored. This is acceptable but worth knowing.
clearRead does not call notifyBadges(). This is harmless, because it only removes read items and the unread count does not change.
